highlights: AI Sidekick speed, streaming, and reliability: Makes Sidekick feel more live with continuous Markdown rendering, smoother answer streaming, faster send paths, cached transcripts, prewarmed runtimes, and stronger retry and recovery handling.

Richer Sidekick inputs and context: Adds voice dictation, file attachments, zipped folder uploads, removable context chips, page context readers, docs search, and more reliable editor and dashboard context.
Sidekick data exploration and artifacts: Adds chat-driven data previews, chart rendering, dashboard chart views, artifact hydration, and safer handling for generated or synthetic preview data.

Data Explorer and data preview: Introduces a Data Explorer entrypoint, exploration UI for existing connections, virtual preview tables, Parquet and remote SQL preview adapters, lineage response handling, and improved row-count behavior.

Pipeline operations and scheduling: Adds pipeline priority, automatic retry settings, retry actions for incomplete block runs and selected integration streams, guarded trigger deletion, clearer runtime variable editing, and Kubernetes execution diagnostics.

Pipeline authoring and graph experience: Improves graph layout, graph workspace controls, relationship labels, dynamic child dependency handling, pipeline downloads, notebook sticky headers, file browser shortcuts, and editor polish.
summary: AI Sidekick speed, streaming, and reliability: Makes Sidekick feel more live with continuous Markdown rendering, smoother answer streaming, faster send paths, cached transcripts, prewarmed runtimes, and stronger retry and recovery handling.
